(ns tx.catalog-probe (:require [datom :as d] [datom.tx :as tx]))
  (defn callback [db amount] [[:db/add 1 :amount amount]])
  (defn public-registration [] (d/register-tx-fn! :probe/public callback))
  (defn low-registration [] (tx/register-fn! :probe/low callback))
  (defn dynamic-registration [key f] (d/register-tx-fn! key f))
  (defn quoted [] '(d/register-tx-fn! :inert callback))
